title: The Gentle Whisper
question: Why was God in the whisper and not in the wind, earthquake, or fire?
blurb: A prophet at the end of himself, and the quiet that met him there.

nodes.content: Why was God in the whisper and not in the wind, earthquake, or fire?

nodes.verseText: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.

Then the LORD said, “Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD. Behold, the LORD is about to pass by.” And a great and mighty wind tore into the mountains and shattered the rocks before the LORD, but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake.
For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence—but you were not willing.”
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.
